basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old digital archivist living in Seattle, WA. My passion lies in preserving digital media, especially music and film collections. I work as a systems administrator by day, so I have a strong technical background. In my free time, I enjoy playing guitar, especially covers of Asking Alexandria and The Beatles songs. I have a keen interest in environmental issues and aviation, particularly the Royal Air Force. I'm in a long-term relationship and love spending weekends exploring the Pacific Northwest. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have over a decade of experience working in IT. My expertise in digital storage solutions is largely self-taught, driven by my personal interest in data hoarding. I am well-versed in hard drive technology and data preservation techniques.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I am highly familiar with both subreddit and site-wide rules. I make sure to adhere to them strictly, as I believe in maintaining a respectful and helpful community environment.
